title: AutoShade · AI-assisted RAW development
excerpt: AI decides what to change. A deterministic Rust engine does it.
content_html:
skymanbp's AutoShade

AI-assisted automatic development of RAW photographs.

Windows · macOS · Linux (CLI) · Open source under MIT

What it is

AI proposes. The engine develops.

A deterministic Rust engine renders AI proposals.

One develop engine

Exposure, white balance, curves, HSL, color grading, texture, clarity, dehaze, detail, crop, and lens-aware local adjustments.

Editable AI proposals

analyze and auto propose and validate recipes against image statistics, render them, and allow one bounded visual-review revision.

Local masks

Linear, radial, brush, luminance-range, color-range; local subject, sky and point-prompted object selection.

Sidecars both ways

Lightroom/ACR round-trip; conservative merges preserve unmodeled fields.

Versions and variants

Ordinary develops, generated targets and reverse-fitted looks stay distinct; the source stays untouched.

Three front ends

Desktop GUI, scriptable CLI, local web UI; one shared library.

Download

Download v1.2.6.

8 assets: 7 files below, plus checksums.txt with their SHA-256.

Installer: current user, no administrator access; upgrades in place preserve develop store and weights. Portable ZIP: executables beside bundled sidecars. macOS universal AutoShade.app: ad-hoc signed, not notarised; first launch needs one Open Anyway per machine.

Open the v1.2.6 release

Quickstart

Desktop

  1. Start autoshade-gui.
  2. Open photo…, Ctrl+O, or drag in a supported photo.
  3. Adjust a Develop slider; compare with the neutral conversion.
  4. Ctrl+Shift+E exports a copy; the original stays untouched.

CLI

autoshade decode "photo.ARW" -o "preview.jpg"
autoshade apply "photo.ARW" "recipe.json" -o "developed.tif"

With the image/vision role configured:

autoshade auto "photo.ARW" --guidance "natural color; protect highlights" -o "developed.tif"

Build and setup →

Showcase · Part A

AI analysis and style transfer

One Sony α7R IVA 61 MP .ARW, three directions, an index of the photographer's 169 Lightroom RAW+XMP edits and 94-photo finished-look library. Recipes render at full resolution; no pixels are copied.

Two pinned local models

SigLIP 2 siglip2-base-patch16-384 puts photographs and Direction text in one 768-dimensional space; Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct writes one sentence on each photograph's grade. Both read the same staged 512 px frame, so a RAW is never decoded twice.

One distance, four terms

d14 + W_EMB(1−cos) + W_TXT(1−cos) + W_DESC(1−cos) over the image, Direction-text and description cosines, shipped at 4 / 0.5 / 0.5. A missing vector contributes zero; zeroed weights reproduce the feature-only ranking exactly.

Weights the harness chose

14 normalized photographic features, z-scored only where the variance is useful. Both Direction-text cosines are standardised across candidates first, and the weights come from a leave-one-out sweep over 169 exemplars.

Showcase · Part B

Reimagine → reverse-fit

Targets can invent content; fitted renders cannot. Fit an editable recipe to the target's look, then apply it to the full RAW.

Supported formats

Nine cameras, 24 RAW extensions.

AutoShade neutral renders, one CC0 file per sample, not embedded previews. The environment-gated release suite last recorded 9/9.

Camera RAW · 24 extensions

arw, dng, raw, raf, nef, cr2, cr3, orf, rw2, pef, srw, 3fr, fff, iiq, mef, mos, erf, kdc, dcr, dcs, crw, nrw, mrw, ari

rawler decodes; its database covers 725 camera models. Twelve formats lack embedded previews; AutoShade displays and identifies its own neutral rendition.

Baked rasters · 8 extensions

jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, bmp, webp, gif

qcms converts ICC profiles when present. Monochrome and four-colour sensor arrays are refused, never reinterpreted as three-channel colour.

Nine format samples from raw.pixls.us under CC0 1.0 Public Domain.

How it works

One binary. Three front ends.

One Rust library; the advisor and external services return bounded recipes, never pixels. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

Three pillars

Three things this does.

Three pillars and their infrastructure, with mathematics and measured results. v1.2.6.

AI analysis develop

Each of your Lightroom RAW+XMP pairs becomes an exemplar with a 14-dimension EXIF+histogram feature, sliders and tone curve. Local models add a 768-D SigLIP 2 vector and Qwen3-VL-2B sentence. Retrieval: 4 nearest past shots by d14 + W_EMB(1−cos) + W_TXT·z(1−cos−hub) + W_DESC·z(1−cos). Leave-one-out corpus winners: W_EMB=4, W_TXT=0.5 and W_DESC=0.5. A capped pull, 0.18 at Style 0.3, moves the proposal toward your means without copying it.

AI full-image generation → editable recipe

reimagine adds a faithfulness scaffold to every prompt: gpt-image-2 silently drops input_fidelity. Below D = 0.35: full solve; at or above: bounded Atmosphere mode. Local order: semantic regions or luminance bands, frozen-evidence quadtree to 4×4, then at most two free-form masks. Each passes the same 3% evidence, D < 0.65 and 0.012 rim gates. The recovered recipe is editable; generated pixels never carry over.

Matching Lightroom

Hand-rolled XML reads and writes Camera Raw's own scope; unknown namespaces survive merges. Measured: Fritsch–Carlson tone LUT, 45 of 45 Lightroom Texture anchors within ±0.02, 290×11 radial feather table. Radials close 41/41 vectors to ≤1 px; linear handles are not pixel-closed: 9.748/7.025/6.336 px RMS. Linear falloff: smoothstep on the measured abscissa t^1.124, rms 0.0064 against 0.0315 for plain smoothstep.

Tech stack & algorithms

The implementation details.

Eight areas; links open equations, provenance, measurements and sources.

RAW decode and CFA

rawler: 24 RAW formats and 725 camera bodies. Approximate X-Trans fits colour planes over a 5×5 CFA neighbourhood; the measured X-S10 G/R ratio moved from 1.5503 to 0.9476. Lightroom sidecar tiff:Orientation chooses quarter turns.

Develop pipeline and tone model

Deterministic f32 rendering: linear-light vignette and dehaze, monotone Fritsch–Carlson tone LUT containing Highlights, then curves, HSL, clarity and local edits. Negative Texture: two measured low-pass arms, A1=0.172443 and A2=0.304888.

Masks

Radial, linear, brush, bitmap, luminance-range and colour-range: Add/Subtract/Intersect. Radial feather uses a measured 290×11 alpha LUT; brush dab flow: kappa=0.1284. The pixel/aspect metric cut D1 error from 874 px to 9.8 px.

AI masks

Subject selection: commit-pinned BiRefNet, named U²-Net fallback. Sky: OneFormer, 150-class ADE20K table. Object gestures: ordered positive points for SAM 2.1 over gp1. Locally derived alpha is disclosed as non-Adobe.

Lens correction and Lightroom mask-frame laws

Sony 0x7037's 16 samples at (i+1)/16 feed a 2048-node/64-knot mask solve; Newton inversion reads rectilinear .lcp profiles and refuses fisheye-only ones. Radials close 41/41 vectors to ≤1 px; linear H2 keeps lines straight and records its RMS residuals.

XMP and Lightroom interoperability

Typed Tag/Scope traversal reads Camera Raw's own scope including nested Look; conservative merge preserves unmodeled fields. Measured domains: LocalExposure2012=EV/4, local Hue /180, other local family /100, global Sharpness 1:1.

AI advisor and reverse fit

Bounded proposals use store:false and a do-no-harm gate. A cast ships only through four vetoes, including foreign hues ≥45° over ≥5% of the frame and a ≥15° hue fan across luminance. Reimagine and heal remain generated-pixel operations.

Application and infrastructure

Rust 2024: one library for CLI, egui desktop and loopback web UI. Server: 32-byte token and Host/Origin/no-store defenses. SCUNet requires sidecar_wrote. A 1771 MB probe set the 1800 MB per-photo budget. The v1.2.6 battery: 1400 library, 24 CLI, 164 GUI and 2+2 contract tests.

Documentation

Follow the implementation.

User manual & CLI reference Install, develop, masks, versions, export, AI roles, privacy, trust boundaries. Architecture Subsystem boundaries and dependency rationale. Full showcase gallery All pairs, panels, directions, references, judge trails and measurements. Release ledger Releases, measurements and standing rulings. MIT license

skymanbp's AutoShade

AI-assisted automatic development of RAW photographs.

Windows · macOS · Linux (CLI) · Open source under MIT

它是什么

AI proposes. The engine develops.

A deterministic Rust engine renders AI proposals.

One develop engine

Exposure, white balance, curves, HSL, color grading, texture, clarity, dehaze, detail, crop, and lens-aware local adjustments.

Editable AI proposals

analyze and auto propose and validate recipes against image statistics, render them, and allow one bounded visual-review revision.

Local masks

Linear, radial, brush, luminance-range, color-range; local subject, sky and point-prompted object selection.

Sidecars both ways

Lightroom/ACR round-trip; conservative merges preserve unmodeled fields.

Versions and variants

Ordinary develops, generated targets and reverse-fitted looks stay distinct; the source stays untouched.

Three front ends

Desktop GUI, scriptable CLI, local web UI; one shared library.

快速入门

桌面

  1. Start autoshade-gui.
  2. Open photo…, Ctrl+O, or drag in a supported photo.
  3. Adjust a Develop slider; compare with the neutral conversion.
  4. Ctrl+Shift+E exports a copy; the original stays untouched.

CLI

autoshade decode "photo.ARW" -o "preview.jpg"
autoshade apply "photo.ARW" "recipe.json" -o "developed.tif"

With the image/vision role configured:

autoshade auto "photo.ARW" --guidance "natural color; protect highlights" -o "developed.tif"

Build and setup →

Showcase · Part A

AI analysis and style transfer

One Sony α7R IVA 61 MP .ARW, three directions, an index of the photographer's 169 Lightroom RAW+XMP edits and 94-photo finished-look library. Recipes render at full resolution; no pixels are copied.

Two pinned local models

SigLIP 2 siglip2-base-patch16-384 puts photographs and Direction text in one 768-dimensional space; Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct writes one sentence on each photograph's grade. Both read the same staged 512 px frame, so a RAW is never decoded twice.

One distance, four terms

d14 + W_EMB(1−cos) + W_TXT(1−cos) + W_DESC(1−cos) over the image, Direction-text and description cosines, shipped at 4 / 0.5 / 0.5. A missing vector contributes zero; zeroed weights reproduce the feature-only ranking exactly.

Weights the harness chose

14 normalized photographic features, z-scored only where the variance is useful. Both Direction-text cosines are standardised across candidates first, and the weights come from a leave-one-out sweep over 169 exemplars.

Showcase · Part B

Reimagine → reverse-fit

Targets can invent content; fitted renders cannot. Fit an editable recipe to the target's look, then apply it to the full RAW.
